"""head_frame_native: Frankenduck head internals R05 head frame, robot world frame, Z up, mm.

Native port of head_frame() in cad_blender/code_cad/head_internals/code/build_parts_r05.py (build123d).
Closed ring around the yaw/roll link bay, printed on its back (x = -25.27 face down):
  1. rear bulkhead + top flange (holds the roll servo by three back-face M2 screws);
  2. U-saddle round the roll servo: -Y wall, +Y wall, bottom bar;
  3. -Y side: 45-degree jog and wall B (sloped to follow the top shell), jaw F688 seat boss, front end block,
     rear -Y shell foot;
  4. +Y side: jog, jaw servo cradle plate (zones R/S/M/C), top flange, rear +Y shell foot, rear-centre foot;
  5. cuts: roll servo boss/cover pockets and plug window, roll M2 holes, jaw F688 seat/passage/retainer,
     jaw servo boss hole and plug+cover window, jaw M2 holes, bulkhead-foot relief.
Every M3 heat-set insert pocket of the source is a self-forming thread hole here (Thomas Sanladerer: bore
d + 0.15 with three 0.4 mm ridges that grow over the entry taper), same axis, entry face and depth; the two
shell-foot holes include the source's screw-tip clearance (z 274..283).
Feature form (sketch/extrude/box/cylinder/combine) is used for every step; raw CadQuery only for the
self-forming hole tools. Rounded profile corners are polygons, 10-degree segments, as in the source.
"""
import math
import cadquery as cq
from steve import Model

# ---- measured datums (world mm)
z0_roll = 280.58  # mm Head roll axis height (world X axis through y 0)
roll_back_x = -20.265  # mm Roll servo back face (pilot lands)
bed_x = -25.27  # mm Print bed face of the frame (back of the rear bulkhead)
frame_top = 300.6  # mm Top of bulkhead, saddle and cradle plate
bar_top = 267.9  # mm Top of the bottom bar under the roll servo
jaw_cx = 35.24  # mm Jaw F688 axis X
jaw_cz = 284.89  # mm Jaw F688 axis Z
jaw_back_y = 17.8  # mm Jaw servo back lands (world Y)
jaw_recess_y = 19.0  # mm Cradle plate face at the recessed servo head end
shell_boss_z = 274.0  # mm Bottom-shell boss tops (shell-foot entry faces)
rear_foot_x = -21.6  # mm Rear-centre shell foot axis X
rear_foot_z = 261.8  # mm Rear-centre shell foot bottom (screw entry)
rear_foot_r = 4.1  # mm Rear-centre shell foot radius
foot_r = 4.2  # mm Rear -Y / +Y shell foot radius
foot_top = 283.0  # mm Top of the -Y / +Y shell feet
# ---- servo back clearances (bare STS3215, aux horn off)
boss_r = 3.5  # mm Passive-boss clearance radius (roll pocket, jaw hole)
boss_pocket = 3.0  # mm Roll passive-boss pocket depth
cover_xl = 9.4  # mm Raised back cover half width (servo local x)
cover_y0 = -30.0  # mm Raised back cover far end (servo local y)
cover_d = 2.2  # mm Roll cover pocket depth
plug_xl = 9.5  # mm Plug window half width (servo local x)
plug_y1 = -12.2  # mm Jaw plug window near end (servo local y)
plug_y0_ry = -17.7  # mm Roll plug window far end (servo local y), R05 6.5 wide
plug_y1_ry = -11.2  # mm Roll plug window near end (servo local y)
# ---- bearing and screws
f688_bore_r = 8.275  # mm Jaw F688 seat bore radius (R05 Ø16.55)
passage_r = 9.3  # mm F688 insertion passage radius through wall B
retainer_r = 10.8  # mm Retainer pilot radius from the jaw axis
retainer_deg = -30.0  # deg Retainer pilot angle in XZ from +X
m2_clr = 2.4  # mm M2 clearance hole diameter
m2_pilot = 1.6  # mm M2 pilot hole diameter
washer_r = 2.6  # mm Retainer washer + head pocket radius
# ---- self-forming M3 holes (replace the source's heat-set insert pockets)
sft_d = 3.0  # mm Screw nominal diameter (M3)
sft_margin = 0.15  # mm Bore oversize over the screw diameter
sft_ridge_h = 0.4  # mm Ridge height into the bore (ridge tips at d + margin - 2 x ridge)
sft_taper = 3.0  # mm Entry length over which the ridges grow, holes 6 mm deep or more
sft_taper_short = 2.0  # mm Entry taper for holes shallower than 6 mm
sft_ridges = 3  # Number of ridges, evenly spaced
flange_hole_depth = 5.5  # mm Bulkhead flange deck holes, from the top face
wallb_hole_depth = 4.5  # mm Wall B end-block front-bulkhead holes, from the front face x 53
foot_hole_depth = 9.0  # mm -Y / +Y shell-foot holes (pocket 5.5 + screw-tip clearance), from below
rear_hole_depth = 4.5  # mm Rear-centre shell-foot hole, from below


def rounded(pts, r):
    """Round every corner of a closed polygon (radius per corner, 0 = sharp), 10-degree segments (source round_poly)."""
    n = len(pts)
    rr = r if isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) else [r] * n
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        p0, p1, p2 = pts[i - 1], pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % n]
        if rr[i] <= 0:
            out.append(tuple(p1))
            continue
        ax, ay = p0[0] - p1[0], p0[1] - p1[1]
        bx, by = p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]
        la, lb = math.hypot(ax, ay), math.hypot(bx, by)
        ax, ay, bx, by = ax / la, ay / la, bx / lb, by / lb
        ang = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, ax * bx + ay * by)))
        if ang < 1e-3 or abs(ang - math.pi) < 1e-3:
            out.append(tuple(p1))
            continue
        t = min(rr[i] / math.tan(ang / 2), 0.45 * la, 0.45 * lb)
        rad = t * math.tan(ang / 2)
        q0 = (p1[0] + ax * t, p1[1] + ay * t)
        q1 = (p1[0] + bx * t, p1[1] + by * t)
        sx, sy = ax + bx, ay + by
        ls = math.hypot(sx, sy)
        k = rad / math.sin(ang / 2) / ls
        c = (p1[0] + sx * k, p1[1] + sy * k)
        a0 = math.atan2(q0[1] - c[1], q0[0] - c[0])
        a1 = math.atan2(q1[1] - c[1], q1[0] - c[0])
        da = (a1 - a0 + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
        m = max(2, int(abs(da) / math.radians(10)) + 1)
        for j in range(m + 1):
            aa = a0 + da * j / m
            out.append((c[0] + rad * math.cos(aa), c[1] + rad * math.sin(aa)))
    clean = [out[0]]
    for p in out[1:]:
        if math.hypot(p[0] - clean[-1][0], p[1] - clean[-1][1]) > 1e-4:
            clean.append(p)
    if math.hypot(clean[0][0] - clean[-1][0], clean[0][1] - clean[-1][1]) < 1e-4:
        clean.pop()
    return clean


def outline(s, pts):
    """Closed polygon as sketch line segments (one line per edge)."""
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        s.line(f"e{i}", tuple(pts[i]), tuple(pts[(i + 1) % len(pts)]))


# jaw servo frame: local (x_l, y_l, z_l) -> world, origin at the horn tip; rows of the rotation
jaw_o = (35.235, 53.0, 284.635)
jaw_rot = ((-0.1045, -0.9945, 0.0), (0.0025, -0.0003, -1.0), (0.9945, -0.1045, 0.0025))


def jaw_world(xl, yl, zl):
    return tuple(jaw_o[i] + jaw_rot[i][0] * xl + jaw_rot[i][1] * yl + jaw_rot[i][2] * zl for i in range(3))


def jaw_xz(pts_l, zl=35.2):
    return [(jaw_world(a, b, zl)[0], jaw_world(a, b, zl)[2]) for a, b in pts_l]


def roll_yz(xl, yl):
    """roll servo local (x_l, y_l) -> world (y, z)"""
    return (yl, z0_roll + xl)


def self_forming_hole(face, axis, depth, taper, d=sft_d, margin=sft_margin, ridge_h=sft_ridge_h, ridges=sft_ridges,
                      overshoot=2.0):
    """Cutting tool for a self-forming thread hole (Sanladerer) entering at point `face` along unit vector `axis`.

    Bore radius r = (d + margin) / 2; each ridge is what a large cylinder (radius R = r + 5) leaves where it overlaps
    the bore by ridge_h, so the ridge tips sit at r - ridge_h. Over the first `taper` mm from the face the overlap
    grows from 0 to ridge_h. The bore also runs `overshoot` mm outside the entry face so the cut opens cleanly.
    Same construction as top_head_shell_native, generalised from +-Z to any axis.
    """
    u = cq.Vector(*axis).normalized()
    e1 = cq.Vector(0, 0, 1).cross(u) if abs(u.z) < 0.9 else cq.Vector(1, 0, 0)
    e1 = e1.normalized()
    e2 = u.cross(e1).normalized()
    p = cq.Vector(*face)
    r = (d + margin) / 2.0
    big_r = r + 5.0
    off = big_r + r - ridge_h
    p_out = p - u * overshoot
    tool = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(r, depth + overshoot, p_out, u)
    for i in range(int(ridges)):
        a = 2.0 * math.pi * i / ridges
        c = e1 * (off * math.cos(a)) + e2 * (off * math.sin(a))
        entry = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(big_r - ridge_h, overshoot, p_out + c, u)
        ramp = cq.Solid.makeCone(big_r - ridge_h, big_r, taper, p + c, u)
        full = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(big_r, depth - taper, p + c + u * taper, u)
        tool = tool.cut(entry.fuse(ramp).fuse(full).clean())
    return tool.clean()


model = Model()

# ================================================================ 1. rear bulkhead + top flange
model.plane("pl_bed", on="YZ", offset=bed_x, name="Print bed face x -25.27")
with model.sketch("sk_bulkhead", on="pl_bed", name="Rear bulkhead profile") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([(-34.0, 264.0), (14.5, 264.0), (14.5, frame_top), (-22.5, frame_top), (-26.0, 298.5),
                        (-30.0, 295.0), (-34.0, 289.0), (-36.4, 285.0), (-36.4, 267.0)], [2, 2, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]))
model.extrude("bulkhead", "sk_bulkhead", distance=roll_back_x - bed_x, op="new", body="frame", name="Rear bulkhead")
with model.sketch("sk_flange", on="pl_bed", name="Bulkhead top flange profile") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([(-22.5, 293.5), (14.5, 293.5), (14.5, frame_top), (-22.5, frame_top)], [1.5, 0, 0, 0]))
model.extrude("flange", "sk_flange", distance=9.0, op="join", body="frame", name="Bulkhead top flange")

# ================================================================ 2. U-saddle round the roll servo
model.plane("pl_sw", on="XZ", offset=35.5, name="Saddle -Y wall outer face y -35.5")
with model.sketch("sk_sw", on="pl_sw", name="Saddle -Y wall profile") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([(-20.27, 264.0), (-10.0, 264.0), (0.0, 274.0), (7.0, 274.0), (7.0, 296.0), (-8.0, 296.0),
                        (-16.0, 291.0), (-20.27, 286.0)], [0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 0]))
model.extrude("saddle_my", "sk_sw", distance=3.1, op="join", body="frame", name="Saddle -Y wall")
model.plane("pl_nw", on="XZ", offset=-14.5, name="Saddle +Y wall face y 14.5")
with model.sketch("sk_nw", on="pl_nw", name="Saddle +Y wall profile") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([(bed_x, 264.0), (1.5, 264.0), (10.2, 272.5), (10.2, frame_top), (bed_x, frame_top)],
                       [0, 3, 0, 0, 0]))
model.extrude("saddle_py", "sk_nw", distance=4.0, op="join", body="frame", name="Saddle +Y wall")
model.box("bottom_bar", 17.27, 47.0, bar_top - 264.0, at=(-11.635, -12.5, (264.0 + bar_top) / 2), op="join", body="frame",
          name="Bottom bar under the roll servo")

# ================================================================ 3. -Y side: jog, wall B, jaw seat boss, end block, foot
model.plane("pl_wy", on="XY", offset=274.6, name="Wall B base z 274.6")
with model.sketch("sk_wy", on="pl_wy", name="-Y jog and wall B plan") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([(-0.5, -35.5), (6.0, -35.5), (13.5, -43.0), (53.0, -43.0), (53.0, -48.0), (14.1, -48.0),
                        (4.7, -38.6), (-0.5, -38.6)], [0, 2, 2, 0, 0, 2, 2, 0]))
model.extrude("wall_b", "sk_wy", distance=24.9, op="new", body="wallb", name="-Y jog and wall B")
model.plane("pl_wout", on="YZ", offset=8.0, name="Wall B slope start x 8")
with model.sketch("sk_wout", on="pl_wout", name="Wall B outer slope") as s:
    outline(s, [(-70.0, 284.0), (-47.5, 284.0), (-43.6, 299.5), (-43.6, 340.0), (-70.0, 340.0)])
model.extrude("wall_b_out", "sk_wout", distance=17.9, op="cut", body="wallb", name="Wall B outer face follows the top shell")
model.plane("pl_win", on="YZ", offset=12.0, name="Wall B inner slope start x 12")
with model.sketch("sk_win", on="pl_win", name="Wall B inner slope") as s:
    outline(s, [(-47.5, 274.6), (-43.0, 274.6), (-43.0, 284.0), (-39.6, 299.5), (-43.6, 299.5), (-47.5, 284.0)])
model.extrude("wall_b_in", "sk_win", distance=13.9, op="join", body="wallb", name="Wall B inner face moved in")
model.combine("join_wallb", "frame", ["wallb"], op="join", name="Join wall B")
model.cylinder("seat_boss", 12.0, 4.0, at=(jaw_cx, -53.0, jaw_cz), direction=(0, 1, 0), op="new", body="seat",
               name="Jaw F688 seat boss r12")
model.cylinder("seat_ring", 14.0, 3.0, at=(jaw_cx, -49.0, jaw_cz), direction=(0, 1, 0), op="join", body="seat",
               name="Seat ring r14 tying the boss to wall B")
model.cylinder("retainer_lobe", 2.6, 5.1,
               at=(jaw_cx + retainer_r * math.cos(math.radians(retainer_deg)), -53.0,
                   jaw_cz + retainer_r * math.sin(math.radians(retainer_deg))),
               direction=(0, 1, 0), op="join", body="seat", name="Lobe round the retainer pilot")
model.box("seat_flat", 80.0, 20.0, 400.0 - 274.6, at=(40.0, -50.0, (274.6 + 400.0) / 2), op="intersect", body="seat",
          name="Seat boss flat at z 274.6")
model.combine("join_seat", "frame", ["seat"], op="join", name="Join jaw seat boss")
model.box("end_block", 4.5, 9.0, 24.6, at=(50.75, -44.5, (274.9 + 299.5) / 2), op="join", body="frame",
          name="Wall B front end block")
model.cylinder("foot_my", foot_r, foot_top - shell_boss_z, at=(4.18, -40.5, shell_boss_z), op="join", body="frame",
               name="Rear -Y shell foot")
model.plane("pl_shell", on="XY", offset=shell_boss_z, name="Shell boss tops z 274")
with model.sketch("sk_foot_my_web", on="pl_shell", name="Rear -Y foot web plan") as s:
    outline(s, [(-5.0, -38.0), (8.4, -38.0), (8.4, -40.5), (4.18, -44.7), (1.1, -44.7)])
model.extrude("foot_my_web", "sk_foot_my_web", distance=foot_top - shell_boss_z, op="join", body="frame",
              name="Rear -Y foot web")

# ================================================================ 4. +Y side: jog, jaw servo cradle plate, feet
model.plane("pl_jn", on="XY", offset=272.5, name="+Y jog base z 272.5")
with model.sketch("sk_jn", on="pl_jn", name="+Y jog plan") as s:
    outline(s, [(8.0, 10.5), (12.5, 15.0), (14.4, 15.0), (14.4, jaw_recess_y), (11.0, jaw_recess_y), (8.0, 16.0)])
model.extrude("jog_py", "sk_jn", distance=frame_top - 272.5, op="join", body="frame", name="+Y jog")
# cradle plate zones: R root, S recessed head end (stepped back face), M lands, C plug-window zone
model.box("cp_r", 9.5, jaw_recess_y - 15.0, 28.1, at=(19.15, 17.0, 286.55), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone R")
model.box("cp_s1", 16.6, jaw_recess_y - 15.5, 2.0, at=(32.2, 17.25, 275.0), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone S1")
model.box("cp_s2", 16.6, jaw_recess_y - 14.5, 9.5, at=(32.2, 16.75, 280.75), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone S2")
model.box("cp_s3", 5.1, jaw_recess_y - 15.0, 7.0, at=(26.45, 17.0, 289.0), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone S3")
model.box("cp_s4", 11.5, jaw_recess_y - 16.0, 7.0, at=(34.75, 17.5, 289.0), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone S4")
model.box("cp_s5", 16.6, jaw_recess_y - 14.5, 8.1, at=(32.2, 16.75, 296.55), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone S5")

model.box("cp_c1", 1.6, jaw_back_y - 14.5, 26.6, at=(47.2, 16.15, 287.3), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle zone C1")
model.plane("pl_cp_c", on="XZ", offset=-jaw_back_y, name="Jaw servo lands y 17.8")
with model.sketch("sk_cp_c", on="pl_cp_c", name="Cradle zone C/F profile") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([(48.0, 267.0), (59.6, 267.0), (59.6, 274.2), (65.8, 274.2), (65.8, 275.1), (74.0, 275.1),
                        (74.0, 306.0), (50.5, 306.0), (50.5, frame_top), (48.0, frame_top)],
                       [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 1.5, 0]))
model.extrude("cp_c2", "sk_cp_c", distance=jaw_back_y - 14.8, op="join", body="frame",
              name="Cradle zone C/F with chord and raised top bar")
model.box("cradle_flange", 33.6, 5.6, 3.0, at=(31.2, 12.8, 299.1), op="join", body="frame", name="Cradle top flange")

               name="Rear +Y shell foot")
with model.sketch("sk_foot_py_arm", on="pl_shell", name="Rear +Y foot arm plan") as s:
    outline(s, [(-10.9, 12.0), (13.1, 12.0), (13.1, 29.65), (8.95, 33.85)])

               name="Rear-centre shell foot")
model.box("rear_foot_clip", 25.27, 20.0, 20.0, at=(bed_x / 2, 0.0, 260.0), op="intersect", body="rfoot",
          name="Clip rear foot at the print bed face")

# One continuous filled corner, replacing the layered wrap.
# Rear bulkhead and saddle outlines define a single convex transition.
# Trim the transition at the existing roll-servo bay; recut every hole below.
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
corner_rear = [(-30.0, 264.0), (-36.4, 264.0), (-36.4, 285.0), (-30.0, 295.0)]
corner_front = [(-35.5, 264.0), (-38.6, 264.0), (-38.6, 293.5), (-35.5, 293.5)]
corner_points = np.array([(bed_x, y, z) for y, z in corner_rear]
                         + [(-12.0, y, z) for y, z in corner_front]
                         + [(-20.27, -38.6, 264.0), (-20.27, -38.6, 289.0)])
corner_hull = ConvexHull(corner_points)
corner_faces = []
for corner_ids, corner_eq in zip(corner_hull.simplices, corner_hull.equations):
    corner_triangle = corner_points[corner_ids]
    if np.dot(np.cross(corner_triangle[1] - corner_triangle[0],
                       corner_triangle[2] - corner_triangle[0]), corner_eq[:3]) < 0:
        corner_triangle = corner_triangle[::-1]
    corner_wire = cq.Wire.makePolygon([cq.Vector(*v) for v in corner_triangle], close=True)
    corner_faces.append(cq.Face.makeFromWires(corner_wire))
corner_solid = cq.Solid.makeSolid(cq.Shell.makeShell(corner_faces)).clean()
corner_servo_void = cq.Solid.makeBox(40.0, 100.0, 80.0, cq.Vector(roll_back_x, -35.5, 250.0))
model.add("saddle_bulkhead_blend", corner_solid.cut(corner_servo_void).clean(),
          op="join", body="frame", name="Single filled bulkhead-saddle corner")

# ================================================================ 5. cuts
# roll servo back: passive-boss pocket, raised-cover pocket, plug window, three M2 clearances
model.cylinder("roll_boss_pocket", boss_r, boss_pocket + 1.0, at=(roll_back_x - boss_pocket, 0.0, z0_roll),
               direction=(1, 0, 0), op="cut", body="frame", name="Roll servo passive-boss pocket")
model.plane("pl_cover", on="YZ", offset=roll_back_x - cover_d, name="Roll cover pocket floor")
with model.sketch("sk_cover", on="pl_cover", name="Roll raised-cover pocket") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([roll_yz(-cover_xl, cover_y0), roll_yz(-cover_xl, plug_y1), roll_yz(cover_xl, plug_y1),
                        roll_yz(cover_xl, cover_y0)], 1.0))
model.extrude("roll_cover_pocket", "sk_cover", distance=cover_d + 1.0, op="cut", body="frame",
              name="Roll servo raised-cover pocket")
model.plane("pl_x30", on="YZ", offset=-30.0, name="Plane x -30")
with model.sketch("sk_roll_plug", on="pl_x30", name="Roll plug window") as s:
    outline(s, rounded([roll_yz(-plug_xl, plug_y0_ry), roll_yz(-plug_xl, plug_y1_ry), roll_yz(plug_xl, plug_y1_ry),
                        roll_yz(plug_xl, plug_y0_ry)], 1.0))
model.extrude("roll_plug_window", "sk_roll_plug", distance=14.0, op="cut", body="frame", name="Roll servo plug window")
model.cylinder("roll_m2_a", m2_clr / 2, 15.0, at=(-30.0, -32.74, 270.32), direction=(1, 0, 0), op="cut", body="frame",
               name="Roll back M2 clearance")
model.cylinder("roll_m2_b", m2_clr / 2, 15.0, at=(-30.0, -8.30, 270.31), direction=(1, 0, 0), op="cut", body="frame",
               name="Roll back M2 clearance")
model.cylinder("roll_m2_c", m2_clr / 2, 15.0, at=(-30.0, -8.30, 290.85), direction=(1, 0, 0), op="cut", body="frame",
               name="Roll back M2 clearance")
# deck screws: self-forming M3 holes down from the bulkhead flange top
